rules.statement: Pending actions under the principal enactment as of 1988 could continue and be completed.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) In view of Section 4(c) of Act No. 4 of 1988 any action, proceeding or thing commenced under the principal enactment and pending and incompleted could be carried on and completed. (ii) The decision made by the Commissioner in 1995, is a direct result of the false declaration of the 1st Respondent and his brother, therefore the decision falls within the parameters of "incomplete thing" and is valid

rules.statement: A decision is valid if it results from a false declaration.
